verdict.rationale: SSO/SAML organization access control is a fair question for a SaaS planning tool like GitHub Projects, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions SSO, SAML, or identity-provider integration. The only access-related item covers API authentication with personal access tokens or GitHub App tokens, which is an adjacent feature and not SSO/SAML.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can secure organization access with SSO and SAML
